ACOUSTIC PET PANELS

PROUDLY MADE IN INDIA, GREENPRO CERTIFIED

India's first startup offering integrated solutions in floorings and acoustic panels for high-performance interiors. GAIA is one of the proud Indian MSME to earn the GreenPro label for our Acoustic PET Panels, showcasing our commitment to environmental sustainability. Made with recycled polyester fibers, our panels deliver top-tier performance while minimizing ecological impact

COMING SOON: NON-WOVEN (FELT) & MACHINE WOVEN CARPETS

SPECIFICATIONS

  • Acoustic Panel boards are made from Recycled Polyester Fiber and are meant to be used for Wall Claddings, Ceilings and Paneling.
  • We have more than 54 Colors in our Bank.
  • Density: 1350-4000 g/m3
  • Acoustic Panel boards can absorb 30% of sound (0.3 NRC) when the panel is directly fixed onto the wall, whereas they can absorb 85% to 90% (0.85 to 0.9 NRC) of the sound when installed correctly with a gap maintained between the wall and the Acoustic Panels.

Experience our products in your own space before making a decision. The TilesView Web Tool is an innovative visualization platform that allows you to see how our premium flooring solutions will look in your actual room setting.

Simply upload a photograph of your room, office space, or any area where you're considering our flooring products. Our advanced visualization technology will seamlessly integrate our carpet tiles, artificial grass, acoustic panels, or broadloom carpets into your space, giving you a realistic preview of how the final result will appear.

HOW IT WORKS

Transform your space visualization in three simple steps

Upload Your Room Photo

Take or upload a clear photograph of the space where you want to visualize our flooring products. The tool works best with well-lit images that show the floor area clearly.

Select Your Product

Browse through our extensive catalog of carpet tiles, artificial grass, acoustic panels, and broadloom carpets. Choose the product, color, and pattern that matches your vision.

Visualize & Reimagine

Watch as our advanced technology seamlessly places the selected product into your space. See how different options transform your room and make an informed decision with confidence.
